WITH patient_means AS (
  SELECT p.ID,
         COALESCE(p.SEX, '') AS SEX,
         AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt,
         AVG(1.0 * l.ALP / NULLIF(l.GPT, 0)) AS avg_alp_gpt_ratio
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS lx
    WHERE lx.ID = p.ID AND lx.`U-PRO` = '-'
  )
  GROUP BY p.ID, COALESCE(p.SEX, '')
)
SELECT SEX,
       AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_patient_pt,
       AVG(avg_alp_gpt_ratio) AS avg_patient_alp_gpt_ratio
FROM patient_means
GROUP BY SEX
